column1: # Measure gates for cpl4_txl_2_line (execution-manifest contract:
# !measures).
# Why measures: a BJT driver into a coupled pair plus a TXL, stepped at
# tmax=0.35 ns against 1 ns edges. The pointwise gate trips on three
# v(2) undershoot-tail samples 13 mV apart on a 4.2 V node. Refining
# ngspice's own step 10x moves its crossings by up to 63 ps, the v(5)
# crosstalk peak by 62 mV (6 percent), and the settled v(2) high mean by
# 42 mV; RSpice's crossings sit within 33 ps, its v(5) peak within 7 mV,
# and its means within 16 mV. The v(4) mean after the rising edge is not
# gated: the reference's own value over [32n,40n] moves 155 mV under
# refinement, wider than any honest tolerance.
# Source: v1 PULSE 0->4 V at 1 ns, 4->0 V at 22 ns (1 ns edges). v(2) =
# driver output, v(4) = far end of the driven line, v(5) = coupled
# line's far end (crosstalk, +-1 V). Tolerances are twice the larger of
# the reference's refinement movement and RSpice's deviation.
